title: Normalized rational ambient, stratum and chart pullback data
statement: For a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, define the actual continuous coefficient pullback, scalar-image map, finite free sheaves and basis sections. Define Pull as the normalized universal derived-to-ordinary counit computing on acyclic-tensor K-flat complexes, its singleMap, and pullAlong from the specified realization Along. Define Composition with the ordinary unit, degreewise and derived normalization equations. Define Stratum, FreeModel and Chart with exactly the coefficient maps, counits, composition comparisons and balanced section formulas. Their comparison isomorphisms are the explicit composites of these supplied data, the realization comparison and the supplied degree-zero identification. These are data and maps only, not an existence assertion. All declarations are the existing ones of the rational stratum pullback module, relocated verbatim.
